subject: general
question: DBW 371 (Karan Vrinda), DBW 303 (Karan Vaishnavi) and DBW 187 (Karan Vandana) are varieties of which crop in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DBW 371 (Karan Vrinda)**, **DBW 303 (Karan Vaishnavi)**, and **DBW 187 (Karan Vandana)** are high-yielding, disease-resistant varieties of **wheat**.
 
• **Wheat** is one of the most important cereal crops globally, and India is the second-largest producer of wheat after China.
 
• These varieties are developed to ensure **better adaptation** to Indian agro-climatic conditions.
 
• Wheat is a **rabi crop**, meaning it is sown in the winter season and harvested in the summer season.
 
• The major wheat-producing states in India include **Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Bihar**.
 
• Wheat is primarily used to produce **flour** for bread, biscuits, cakes, pasta, and noodles, making it a staple food for millions.
 
• The development of improved wheat varieties like DBW 371, DBW 303, and DBW 187 is part of India's effort to achieve **food security** and meet the demands of its growing population.
 
• India has achieved significant progress in wheat production due to the **Green Revolution**, which introduced high-yielding varieties and modern agricultural practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rice**__

 __
 
• **Rice** is the staple food for a large portion of the global population, especially in Asia.
 
• India is the second-largest producer of rice in the world after China.
 
• The **Indica** and **Japonica** types of rice are the most cultivated varieties globally.
 
• Some popular high-yielding rice varieties in India include **IR-64, BPT 5204, and Pusa Basmati**.
 
 
 
• **Tea**__
 __
 
• Tea is one of the most consumed beverages worldwide and is cultivated mainly in tropical and subtropical regions.
 
• India is one of the largest producers of tea, with major production in **Assam, West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala**.
 
• The most famous varieties of Indian tea include **Assam Tea, Darjeeling Tea, and Nilgiri Tea**.
 
 
 
• **Maize**__
 
 
• **Maize**, also known as corn, is a versatile crop used for food, feed, and industrial purposes.
 
• It is a **kharif crop** in India, mainly cultivated during the monsoon season.
 
• India's major maize-producing states are **Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh**.
